description: Defines types, constants, enums, and structures related to E1AP protocol messages and identifiers used in 3GPP network components, including UE IDs, QoS parameters, PDCP configurations, and session management structures.

classes.name: e1ap_cell_group_info_item
classes.description: Represents information about a cell group, including ID and optional configurations.

classes.name: e1ap_qos_flow_level_qos_params
classes.description: Contains QoS characteristics and related parameters for a QoS flow.

classes.name: e1ap_qos_flow_qos_param_item
classes.description: Associates a QoS flow ID with its QoS parameters and mapping indication.

classes.name: e1ap_qos_flow_map_item
classes.description: Represents a QoS flow ID and its mapping direction.

classes.name: e1ap_data_forwarding_info_request
classes.description: Holds data forwarding request string and associated QoS flow forwarding info.

classes.name: e1ap_pdcp_count
classes.description: Tracks PDCP sequence number and hyper frame number.

classes.name: e1ap_drb_status_transfer
classes.description: Contains PDCP transfer count and optional received status.

classes.name: e1ap_pdcp_sn_status_info
classes.description: Holds UL and DL PDCP SN status transfer info.

classes.name: e1ap_rohc_params
classes.description: Parameters for ROHC compression, including max CID and profiles.

classes.name: e1ap_rohc_config
classes.description: Configuration for ROHC including type and parameters.

classes.name: e1ap_pdcp_config
classes.description: PDCP configuration parameters including SN sizes, RLC mode, and optional features.

classes.name: e1ap_drb_to_setup_item_ng_ran
classes.description: Details for setting up a DRB in NG RAN, including QoS and forwarding info.

classes.name: e1ap_pdu_session_res_to_setup_item
classes.description: Information for setting up a PDU session resource.

classes.name: e1ap_security_algorithm
classes.description: Defines ciphering and integrity algorithms for security.

classes.name: e1ap_up_security_key
classes.description: Contains encryption and integrity protection keys.

classes.name: e1ap_security_info
classes.description: Aggregates security algorithms and keys.

classes.name: e1ap_up_params_item
classes.description: Represents uplink transport layer info and cell group ID.

classes.name: e1ap_qos_flow_item
classes.description: Represents a QoS flow ID.

classes.name: e1ap_qos_flow_failed_item
classes.description: QoS flow ID with failure cause.

classes.name: e1ap_drb_setup_item_ng_ran
classes.description: Details for setting up a DRB in NG RAN, including transport params and QoS.

classes.name: e1ap_drb_failed_item_ng_ran
classes.description: Details of a failed DRB setup with cause.

classes.name: e1ap_pdu_session_res_to_modify_item
classes.description: Information for modifying a PDU session resource.

classes.name: e1ap_ng_ran_bearer_context_mod_request
classes.description: Request to modify NG RAN bearer contexts for PDU sessions.

classes.name: e1ap_drb_modified_item_ng_ran
classes.description: Details of a modified DRB in NG RAN.

classes.name: e1ap_pdu_session_resource_modified_item
classes.description: Details of a modified PDU session resource.
